selection_lock.selection_rule: Prequential race-weighted CRPS; tail-capable candidate must retain MAE within 10% of best simple benchmark; otherwise declare simple net-only fallback
selection_lock.calibration_rule: P8 only; scale learned from strictly earlier validation races, minimum two prior races and ten cases; final refit uses validation only

measurement_agreement.shared_bias_warning: Both estimators share provider lap timing, pre-stop anchors and structural assumptions
